headline: The eight planner classes are named in the image: Defend, Attack, Sell and Capture fill brain+0h..+0Ch for game modes 0..3, and Duel, Escort, Siege and Competitive fill brain+10h..+1Ch, one per mode 4..7. 00A15A70 constructs only one of the two sets, never both.

routines.name: BSP_AiPartyBrain_Construct
routines.note: Eight allocation arms. Modes 4..7 construct exactly one mode planner (38h each) and leave brain+0h..+0Ch null; any other mode constructs the first four (38h, 38h, 38h, 44h) and leaves brain+10h..+1Ch null. brain+20h = party, brain+24h = 009FFD60().

routines.abi: __thiscall(planner)(AiGroup* group, float aggressive, bool resetTarget), RET 0Ch
routines.note: Argument order from the Attack think's pushes at 00A1CFEE/00A1CFF0/00A1CFF4 and the Siege think's at 00A265C8/00A265CA/00A265D0; EBX = [ESP+40h] at 00A1CB89 is the group. Scores every group of g_aiGroupsByTeam[planner+34h] as sticky*ownSet*base*range and orders the maximum attacked.

routines.name: BSP_AiGroup_CommandIsEngaged
routines.note: IsType(6) or IsType(10) is engaged; IsType(2) is engaged while the squared planar distance from command+8h/+10h exceeds 00CE3D64 (10000.0f).

routines.name: BSP_AiGroup_OrderAttackOnGroup
routines.note: ECX established from MOV ECX,EBX at 00A1CEED with EBX the group. Keeps the command when already attacking target; builds CAUTIOUSATTACK (2Ch) when the first member's vtable +5Ch(6) is false, 00A2C9F0 accepts the position and 00BD2F40() > aggressive; otherwise MOVETOATTACK (20h).

corrections.was: the brain is 28h bytes: +0h..+0Ch four planners, all ticked through vtable[+20h] every think; +10h..+1Ch mode-specific planners for modes 4..7
corrections.is: the brain is 28h bytes but only one of the two sets exists at a time. 00A15A70 branches on 004BCA50 and for modes 4..7 constructs exactly one mode planner, leaving +0h..+0Ch null; for any other mode it constructs the first four and leaves +10h..+1Ch null.
corrections.evidence: 00A15A70 body 00a15a70-00a15ce3, the eight arms at 00A15ADA, 00A15B31, 00A15B88, 00A15BDF, 00A15C31, 00A15C61, 00A15C92, 00A15CC3, each guarded by the CMP against 004BCA50's result at 00A15AB7
